description: ㅤㅤ familie redlich wurde 2001 von Andre Redlich in Berlin gegründet. Das Ziel: Kommunikation, die was bewegt. Für Unternehmen, Institutionen, Produkte und Marken. Das Angebot: Echte crossmediale Kommunikation, Themen- und Mobilisierungs-Kampagnen sowie ganzheitlicher, klassischer und kreativer Full Service. Zielgruppenspezifisch und mit Sinn und Verstand. Bei uns findest du spannende Themen, kluge Köpfe, nette Menschen – und eine Menge Spaß bei der Arbeit. Das liegt einerseits an den Aufgaben unserer Kund:innen, für die wir aus Überzeugung unser Bestes geben. Und andererseits an den Menschen, mit denen wir gerne zusammenarbeiten. Respekt und gegenseitige Wertschätzung machen’s möglich. Wie wir arbeiten? Mit guten Prozessen und einer Menge Leidenschaft und Herzblut. Das klingt nicht nur gut. Das fühlt sich auch so an. Das machst du bei uns: Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Grafikdesign unterstützt du unsere Kreation bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von visuellen Inhalten für Social Media und digitale Kampagnen. Dabei arbeitest du an Grafiken, Animationen und Videos für unsere Kund:innen – vor allem aus dem Bereich der gesellschaftspolitischen Kommunikation. Du arbeitest in einem 13-köpfigen Kreativteam, in dem unterschiedliche gestalterische Handschriften, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammenkommen. In unseren Dailys und im engen Austausch miteinander lernst du von erfahrenen Designer:innen, bringst deine Ideen ein und entwickelst dich fachlich und kreativ weiter. Du unterstützt bei der Gestaltung von Social-Media-Content (Postings, Stories, Reels und Ads) sowie beim Schnitt und der Animation von kurzen Videoformaten. Dabei bringst du deine gestalterischen Ideen aktiv in den kreativen Prozess ein. Du wirkst an der Produktion und dem Schnitt von Videocontent mit und unterstützt bei der Postproduktion von Material aus Drehs, Events und Eigenproduktionen. Das bringst du mit: Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule im Bereich Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast noch mindestens 12 Monate deines Studiums vor dir. Du kennst die gestalterischen Anforderungen und aktuellen Trends verschiedener Social-Media-Plattformen und hast ein gutes Gespür für visuelle Kommunikation und plattformspezifischen Content. Du hast Spaß daran, dich schnell in komplexe und gesellschaftlich relevante Themen einzuarbeiten und Inhalte visuell verständlich und ansprechend aufzubereiten. Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in der Adobe Creative Suite (insbesondere Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro und After Effects) sowie erste Erfahrungen in der Videobearbeitung und Animation mit. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kommunizierst offen und bringst Motivation, Begeisterungsfähigkeit sowie Eigeninitiative mit. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1). Freuen kannst du dich bei uns auf: Zeitgemäße Arbeitskultur: Im stetigen Austausch miteinander probieren immer wieder neue Wege aus. Flexibilität und Verantwortung: Arbeitszeiten, die zu dir, deinem Team und deinen Aufgaben passen und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten im Team sind uns wichtig. Offene Unternehmenskultur: Entspannte Arbeitsatmosphäre, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen zeichnen uns aus. Genauso wie ein starker Teamzusammenhalt und ein wertschätzender und respektvoller Umgang miteinander. Raum und Zeit für Teamaustausch: Zweimal im Jahr diskutieren unsere Teams in Klausuren abseits des Alltags über selbstgewählte Themen. Offene, helle und moderne Räume, Massagen in der Agentur, tolle Agenturfeste, kostenlose Getränke, ein hundefreundliches Büro – und natürlich offene und sehr nette Kolleg:innen, die sich auf dich freuen! Kontakt Klingt alles richtig gut für dich? Dann los! company: VRT Partnerschaft mbB Wirtschaftsprüfer Steuerberater Rechtsanwälte
description: Du möchtest IT nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Senior Systemadministrator (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unserem Team eine moderne IT-Infrastruktur, bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für zukunftsorientierte Projekte. Dabei erwarten dich kurze Entscheidungswege, moderne Technologien und die Möglichkeit, unsere IT aktiv mitzugestalten. Dein Aufgabenbereich Bei uns gestaltest du, statt zu verwalten: Wir suchen keinen Administrator (m/w/d), der lediglich bestehende Systeme betreut. Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere IT-Infrastruktur kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt, Optimierungspotenziale erkennt und eigene Ideen einbringt. Moderne IT braucht stabile Systeme: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Server-, Netzwerk- und Client-Infrastruktur zuverlässig funktioniert und unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen jederzeit auf eine leistungsfähige IT vertrauen können. Digitalisierung endet nicht bei der Technik: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team moderne Lösungen rund um Microsoft 365, Citrix und unsere Serverlandschaft weiter und unterstützt dabei, Prozesse effizienter und zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Herausforderungen, statt Routine: Ob spannende Infrastrukturprojekte, neue Technologien oder komplexe technische Fragestellungen – bei uns erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben statt monotones Tagesgeschäft. Verantwortung bedeutet Vertrauen: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst deine technische Expertise in Entscheidungen ein und hast die Möglichkeit, unsere IT-Landschaft nachhaltig mitzugestalten. Wissen wächst im Austausch: Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragestellungen und teilst dein Know-how innerhalb des Teams. Gleichzeitig profitierst du vom fachlichen Austausch mit erfahrenen IT-Experten. Deine Vorteile bei der VRT Geld, Zusatzleistungen, Ausgleich: Faires Gehalt, Prämien, Zuschüsse, Rabatte, Gutscheinkarte, bezahlte Überstunden oder Freizeit-Ausgleich – bei der VRT stimmt das Gesamt-Paket, auch unterm Strich! Gleitzeit, Vollzeit oder Teilzeit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, von Vollzeit in Teilzeit und wieder zurück – bring alles unter einen Hut, was dir am Herzen liegt! Updates, Fortbildungen: Schnittstellen zu unserem DATEV-Anwendersupport, individuelle Fortbildungen u. v. m. – wir bringen dich weiter! Team-Events, Sportangebote, Betriebsausflüge, Weihnachtsfeier, Karnevalsfeier, Lauf- und Fitness-Termine, Urban Sports und EGYM Wellpass, Firmenläufe u. v. m. – wir bei der VRT sind von Natur aus sehr gesellig! Erfahrung, auf die wir bauen können: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als IT Systemadministrator (m/w/d) und bewegst dich sicher in Microsoft-Umgebungen sowie modernen Server- und Netzwerkinfrastrukturen. Technik begeistert dich: Du hast Freude daran, neue Technologien kennenzulernen, bestehende Systeme zu optimieren und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln. Eigeninitiative ist für dich selbstverständlich: Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst über den Tellerrand hinaus und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ins Team ein. Kommunikation gehört für dich dazu: Du kannst technische Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln und arbeitest gerne mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlicher Fachbereiche zusammen. Bewirb dich jetzt bei der VRT! Mit rund 290 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern und 20 Partnern an unseren neun Standorten (Bad Honnef, Bonn , Euskirchen, Füssen, Gemünd, Köln, Meckenheim, Rheinbach, Siegburg) arbeiten wir jeden Tag aufs Neue an interessanten Aufgabenstellungen für kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen, größere Unternehmen (MDax) sowie Existenzgründer und Privatpersonen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung, Rechtsberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC). title: (Senior) Product Designer (f/m/d)
description: Description You will design the end-to-end product experience through which semiconductor engineers plan, set up, conduct, and evaluate experiments using our quantum sensing and metrology systems. This journey begins before a user opens the software: it includes experiment planning, sample preparation and mounting, instrument configuration, measurement, data analysis, and reporting. While the majority of your work will focus on our software platform, you will design across the complete hardware-software workflow. You will consider how users move between physical equipment, samples, controls, system states, and digital interfaces - and identify opportunities to make the entire process more intuitive, reliable, and efficient. Working closely with engineers, physicists, machine learning specialists, and customers, you will lead design challenges from discovery and workflow definition through validation and delivery. This is an opportunity to shape products at the intersection of scientific instrumentation, software, hardware, and user-centered design. Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. Why join us? Picture this: Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on earth, right where two frontier fields collide. Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. Still unsure about why joining us? You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors. Let’s make the invisible visible! What will you do Own the end-to-end user experience across experiment planning, sample mounting, instrument setup, calibration, measurement, data analysis, and reporting. Develop a deep understanding of laboratory workflows, user goals, environmental constraints, dependencies, and potential sources of error. Map complete user journeys across physical and digital touch points, identifying friction, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Design workflows and interfaces for our quantum sensing software platform, from early concepts through implementation-ready specifications. Conduct contextual research, customer interviews, workflow observations, and usability testing with internal users and external customers. Prototype and evaluate software interactions and hardware-adjacent workflows, including instrument configuration, system feedback, and error recovery. Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and clear interaction specifications in Figma. Design effective visualizations for measurement data, simulation results, system states, uncertainty, confidence indicators, and potential errors. Collaborate with engineers, physicists, machine learning specialists, and product stakeholders to translate user needs and technical constraints into effective experiences. Facilitate design reviews, explain the evidence and trade-offs behind decisions, and work with engineering throughout implementation to ensure quality and consistency. Develop and maintain a scalable design system across the software platform and connected instrument experiences. Contribute to product discovery, prioritization, and new product capabilities, while documenting research findings, user workflows, design decisions, and interaction patterns. Senior candidates may also lead ambiguous cross-product initiatives, influence product strategy, mentor colleagues, and help establish design practices across the organization. What is expected of you Professional experience designing complex B2B, technical, scientific, industrial, or data-intensive products, supported by a strong portfolio covering research, workflow and interaction design, prototyping, validation, and collaboration with engineering teams. The ability to understand and improve journeys spanning software, hardware, physical processes, and operational constraints, while simplifying complex systems without removing important functionality, context, or user control. Strong interaction design, information architecture, and visual design skills, with experience conducting user research and usability testing and applying the findings to product decisions. Confidence owning design work from discovery and problem definition through delivery, including identifying usability risks, sources of error, and opportunities to improve the reliability and efficiency of technical workflows. Strong communication and facilitation skills when working with highly technical stakeholders, combined with a user-centered, analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative approach. A background in interaction design, product design, human-computer interaction, industrial design, computer science, or equivalent professional experience, together with the ability and willingness to work closely with a multidisciplinary team on-site in Munich. Depending on your level of experience, different things matter: At a mid-level, you're comfortable independently owning defined product areas and end-to-end workflows. At a senior level, you're additionally able to lead ambiguous initiatives, influence product direction, align stakeholders across disciplines, and raise design quality across teams. Nice to have: Experience designing products that combine software, hardware, and physical interactions, particularly scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, engineering software, industrial systems, or other complex technical products. Familiarity with laboratory workflows, sample handling, equipment configuration, experimental processes, service design, journey mapping, systems thinking, or human-factors design. Experience with data visualization, analytics products, simulation software, or safety-critical, error-sensitive, and high-precision workflows. Experience creating or maintaining design systems, familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design practices, or basic knowledge of Python, Qt, Git, or version-controlled workflows. Programming experience is not required for this role. Our benefits Mission : At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. Impact & growth : This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. Deine Mission bei uns Steuerung unseres Marketing-Projektportfolios: Du planst, priorisierst und steuerst mehrere Marketingprojekte gleichzeitig – von Produkt- und Vertical-Launches über Kampagnen und Messeauftritte bis hin zu strategischen C-Level-Sonderprojekten. Ausgeprägte Projektmanagement-Kompetenz: Du verstehst es, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu steuern, komplexe Vorhaben in klare Arbeitspakete zu strukturieren und unterschiedliche Stakeholder erfolgreich zu koordinieren. Dabei arbeitest du sicher mit klassischen und agilen Projektmanagement-Methoden. Mehrjährige Marketing-Erfahrung: Du verfügst über mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung im Marketing, idealerweise im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld. Das Zusammenspiel von Performance Marketing, CRM, Content und Conversion ist dir bestens vertraut und du verstehst, wie erfolgreiche Marketingprojekte kanalübergreifend umgesetzt werden. Kommunikationsstärke & strategisches Denken: Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf, formulierst überzeugende Briefings und Entscheidungsvorlagen und kommunizierst souverän mit internen Teams, Agenturen und dem Management. Hands-on-Mentalität & Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Projekte mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch erfolgreich zum Abschluss. Auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit wechselnden Prioritäten behältst du den Überblick. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Startup- oder HealthTech-Umfeld: Erfahrungen in schnell wachsenden Startups oder Scale-ups sowie Kenntnisse regulierter Märkte wie HealthTech oder Telemedizin sind ein Plus. Erste Berührungspunkte mit Tools wie Figma oder Adobe sowie ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung runden dein Profil ab. Was wir dir bieten Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten. 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester. Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir. Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen. raw.title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
raw.description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


Your playing field

Here's why this role matters for our mission.

  • Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
  • As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
  • Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.


How you'll make a difference

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the table

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


Benefits

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

Wir sind digital, innovativ, kundenzentriert und hochmotiviert mit Dir zusammen Großes zu schaffen. title: Werkstudent Innovation (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission bei EEF Als Werkstudent:in Innovation unterstützt du dabei, neue Technologien, Märkte und Geschäftsmodelle für die Energiewende zu identifizieren und weiterzuentwickeln. Du analysierst Zukunftsthemen wie Batteriespeicher, Datacenter, Wärmeversorgung oder integrierte Energiekonzepte und hilfst dabei, aus innovativen Ideen konkrete Handlungsoptionen und Projekte für die EEF abzuleiten. Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle von Technologie, Wirtschaft und Strategie. Du hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze, bringst neue Perspektiven ein und unterstützt unser Team dabei, Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und die Zukunft der Energieversorgung aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Aufgaben Technologie-, Markt- & Geschäftsmodellentwicklung: Du beobachtest neue Technologien, Markttrends und Geschäftsmodelle rund um die Energiewende. Dabei führst du Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen durch, erstellst Benchmarks und bewertest Potenziale für die EEF. Energiekonzepte & Technologiebewertung: Du beschäftigst dich mit aktuellen und zukünftigen Entwicklungen des Energiesystems und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung integrierter Energiekonzepte. Dabei bewertest du neue Technologien hinsichtlich technischer, wirtschaftlicher, regulatorischer und organisatorischer Chancen und Risiken. Analysen & Entscheidungsvorbereitung: Du bereitest komplexe Fragestellungen verständlich und strukturiert auf. Dazu gehören Marktanalysen, Präsentationen, Business Cases und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Management und Fachbereiche. Pilotprojekte & Umsetzung: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung und Begleitung von Pilotprojekten und wirkst dabei mit, die Voraussetzungen für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung und Integration innovativer Lösungen in die Organisation zu schaffen. Dafür unterstützt du bei der Gestaltung von Prozessen, Standards und Workflows. Innovation & Netzwerk: Du recherchierst relevante Marktakteure, Start-ups, Forschungseinrichtungen und Partner. Zudem beobachtest du aktuelle Entwicklungen im Markt, bringst neue Ideen ein und unterstützt bei Innovationsworkshops, Veranstaltungen und bereichsübergreifenden Projekten. Das bringst du mit Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau, Regenerative Energiesysteme oder einen vergleichbaren technischen oder wirtschaftlich-technischen Studiengang. Begeisterung für Innovation & Energiewende: Du interessierst dich für neue Technologien, innovative Geschäftsmodelle und die Transformation des Energiesystems. Neue Themen motivieren dich und du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Fragestellungen ein. Analytisches Denkvermögen: Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen, Informationen zu strukturieren und fundierte Schlussfolgerungen abzuleiten. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Inhalte verständlich aufbereiten und überzeugend darstellen, sowohl schriftlich als auch im persönlichen Austausch. Eigeninitiative & Umsetzungsstärke: Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Statt Probleme nur zu beschreiben, entwickelst du eigene Ideen und treibst Themen aktiv voran. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Deine Arbeitsweise Du gehst Themen neugierig, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative an. Neue Fragestellungen motivieren dich und du hast Freude daran, dich in unbekannte Themenfelder einzuarbeiten. Dabei denkst du analytisch, verbindest unterschiedliche Perspektiven miteinander und verlierst auch bei komplexen Zusammenhängen nicht den Überblick. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, suchst aktiv nach Lösungen und bringst deine Ideen offen in Diskussionen ein. Das bieten wir dir Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: 18€/Stunde im Bachelor, 21€/Stunde im Master. Urlaubsregelung: 24 Tage Jahresurlaub. Essenszuschuss: Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Mittagessen. Weiterbildung: Vielfältige und personalisierte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben: Spannende Projekte in einem innovativen Unternehmen mit offener Unternehmenskultur. Teamevents: Wöchentliches Team-Frühstück und Cocktail-Freitag. Office: Modernes Büro mit Dachterrasse und zahlreichen Möglichkeiten zur Freizeitgestaltung. Warum EEF? Gestalte die Energiewende aktiv mit: Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die direkten Einfluss auf die Energieversorgung von morgen haben und einen echten Beitrag zur Dekarbonisierung leisten. Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: Wir geben dir früh Verantwortung und ermöglichen dir, eigene Ideen einzubringen und echte Wirkung zu erzielen. Lernen von erfahrenen Expert:innen: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Innovation, Projektentwicklung, Technik, Finanzierung und Strategie zusammen und erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Energiewirtschaft. Ein Umfeld für Macher:innen: Wir setzen auf Eigenverantwortung, Pragmatismus und kurze Entscheidungswege. Gute Ideen zählen mehr als Hierarchien. Flexibilität & Teamkultur: Dich erwartet ein motiviertes Team, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen und eine Kultur, die von Vertrauen, Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung geprägt ist. title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (alle Geschlechter)
description: Deine High-Speed Mission Zu Speed Kit Speed Kit macht die Shops und Websites unserer Kunden messbar schneller, und schnellere Seiten heißen mehr Umsatz. Zu unseren Kunden gehören einige der bekanntesten E-Commerce-Marken in Deutschland und Europa. Zu deiner Rolle Customer Success bei uns ist deshalb keine Zufriedenheitsverwaltung, sondern die Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Kunde live geht, den Effekt auf sein Geschäft nachvollziehen kann und langfristig bleibt. Die initiale Unterschrift holen unsere Account Executives. Danach sitzt du im Driver Seat: Du bringst den Kunden durch Trial oder POC über die Ziellinie und behältst ihn anschließend in deinem Portfolio. Der Kunde bleibt deiner, mit allem was dazugehört. Was du verantwortest Du führst Trials und POCs deiner Neukunden: Du steuerst Integration und Konfiguration mit unserem Team und dem Kunden, koordinierst A/B-Test-Setup und Auswertung und hältst die Stakeholder zusammen. Du erkennst früh, wenn ein Projekt kippt, und drehst es. Du führst die Onboarding-Projekte als echte Projektleitung, von Kickoff über Go-live bis zur Ergebnispräsentation. Das ist der Schwerpunkt der Rolle. Du betreust deine Bestandskunden aus eigenem Antrieb. Du gehst auf deine Accounts zu, bevor sie sich melden, kennst ihre Roadmap und ihre Relaunches und bringst regelmäßig Ergebnisse und Ideen an den Tisch. Du trägst Umsatzverantwortung für dein Portfolio: Verlängerungen, Commitment-Upgrades, Überschreitungen, Ausbau in weitere Domains, Marken und Länder. Du weißt jederzeit, wo dein Book steht und warum. Und weil dein Erfolg unser Erfolg ist, profitierst du auch entsprechend davon. Du führst Kundengespräche auf Basis von Daten: Core Web Vitals, CrUX, Conversion-Uplift, ROI. Du kannst einen Uplift erklären und auch eine Verschlechterung, ohne auszuweichen. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI. Analysen, Reporting, Datenrecherche über unsere Systeme, Entwürfe für Kundenkommunikation: das machst du mit Claude und Gemini und baust dir eigene wiederverwendbare Workflows dafür. Wir erwarten kein Coding, aber wir erwarten, dass du dir selbst Hebel baust, statt Dinge manuell abzuarbeiten. Du bist die Spinne im Netz. Niemand im Unternehmen weiß so viel über unsere Kunden wie du, und du bringst dieses Wissen in alle Teams, von Engineering und Product über Sales bis zur Geschäftsführung. Wie es bei uns wirklich läuft Das Customer Success Team ist eine kleine, extrem eingespielte Truppe und liefert unseren Kunden echten, messbaren Mehrwert. Das ist eine High-Impact-Rolle: Was du bewegst, ist sofort sichtbar, im Ergebnis des Kunden und in unseren Zahlen. Dazu extrem flache Hierarchien, kein Freigabetheater, direkte Gespräche mit Engineering, Product und Geschäftsführung. Was du entscheidest, gilt. Dafür brauchst du aber auch eine eigene Meinung und den Mut, sie auszusprechen. Wenn du etwas anders siehst, sagst du es, und du bleibst dabei, auch wenn jemand widerspricht. Wir haben mehr Projekte als Hände. Ein Teil deiner Woche wird von außen bestimmt, deshalb ist gute Triage entscheidend: Du erkennst, welches der zehn offenen Themen heute Umsatz bewegt oder einen Kunden hält, und was warten kann. Du bekommst von uns Ziele, Kontext und Rückendeckung, aber niemand sortiert deine Prioritäten für dich. Dazu gehört auch, dass du den Mund aufmachst, wenn es brennt: nicht bei jeder Unsicherheit, sondern nachdem du selbst ernsthaft versucht hast, das Problem zu lösen. Keine Probleme, die drei Wochen im Stillen wachsen, und keine Eskalation für jede Frage, die du selbst beantworten könntest. Dein Ticket für unser Raumschiff Mindestens 2 Jahre Customer Success oder Account Management im B2B SaaS Erfahrung in der Steuerung technischer Onboarding-, Trial- oder Implementierungsprojekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite Erfahrung mit oder klare Bereitschaft zu echter Umsatzverantwortung. Du willst, dass dein Ergebnis an Kundenerfolg hängt, statt es zu vermeiden. AI-Tools als tägliches Arbeitsmittel. Das ist harte Voraussetzung und kein Pluspunkt. Wir werden dich im Bewerbungsprozess bitten, konkret zu zeigen, was du mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Tools gebaut oder automatisiert hast. "Ich nutze ChatGPT manchmal für E-Mails" reicht dafür nicht. Selbstbewusstsein und Standing. Du trittst gegenüber Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe auf, führst auch unangenehme Gespräche über Preise, Verzögerungen und Erwartungen, und widersprichst einem Kunden freundlich, wenn er falsch liegt. Digitale Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Ein neues System bringst du dir selbst bei, statt auf eine Schulung zu warten. Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit und saubere Priorisierung unter Last Zahlen- und Datenaffinität. Du arbeitest sicher mit Traffic- und Performance-Metriken und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher Nice-to-have Verständnis von Web Performance, Core Web Vitals und dem Google CrUX Report Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM E-Commerce-Hintergrund, idealerweise mit Shopsystemen wie Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopware oder Magento Warum einsteigen? Wir richten dir deinen Arbeitsplatz ein - vom Bildschirm bis zum Bürostuhl Wähle dein OS: Du kannst dein Betriebssystem frei wählen zwischen Mac, Windows oder Linux Schönes Büro: Arbeiten im Herzen des Hamburger Schanzenviertels Haustierfreundliches Büro: Du darfst gerne einen pelzigen Freund mitbringen Tolle Kolleg:innen: Kompetentes und humorvolles Team Flexibel arbeiten: Arbeite nach einem Vollzeit- oder Teilzeitplan Flache Hierarchien: Die besten Ideen gewinnen, egal von wem Event-Slots: Mehrmals im Jahr könnt ihr abstimmen, was gemacht wird - wolltest Du nicht schon immer mal mit deinen Kolleg:innen Kart fahren? Vote for it! Speed.Fest: Wir treffen uns jedes Quartal alle gemeinsam in unserem HQ in Hamburg für Workshops, gutes Essen, Events und eine tolle Zeit Persönliches Ausbildungsbudget: Wir helfen Dir, Deine Karriere und Deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen Monatliches, flexibles Benefit Budget: 50€ pro Monat, dass Du frei auf das für Dich passende Benefit verteilen kannst - von ÖPNV über Shopping Gutscheine bis hin zur Gym-Mitgliedschaft Zukunftssichere Altersvorsorge: Bringe deine Altersvorsorge mit oder lass dich von unseren Experten beraten Countdown 4️⃣… Du teilst deinen Lebenslauf, dein LinkedIn oder Xing-Profil mit uns. 3️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein erstes ausführliches (Video-)Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success zum Kennenlernen (45~60 Minuten). Wenn wir beide großes Interesse haben, bekommst du danach eine Case-Study-Simulation aus unserem echten Arbeitsalltag. Aufwand: maximal 2 Stunden, mehr wollen wir dir nicht zumuten. 2️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success und einem Mitglied des CSM-Teams, inklusive Präsentation deiner Case-Study-Simulation (60~90 Minuten). 1️⃣… Abschlussgespräch mit unserem CEO (ca. 30 Minuten). Passt es für beide Seiten, bereiten wir den Vertrag vor. …0️⃣ Du steigst ein in unser Raumschiff! title: Senior Endpoint Engineer
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We're looking for a Sr Endpoint Engineer who's excited about consolidating and updating legacy systems with an eye for automation. You'll be responsible for the MDM platforms, endpoint policies, device deployment pipelines, and fleet tooling that underpin how every employee at Wave interacts with their device. This role blends architectural ownership with hands-on execution, requiring you to deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant endpoint solutions in a fast growth environment. You'll own the endpoint function end-to-end: platform and policy design, provisioning standards, fleet reporting, and security integration. You'll work closely with Information Security, IT, and People Operations, and you'll be the person who sets the technical direction for how Wave manages devices at scale. The first year will be weighted toward remediation and foundation-building before shifting toward automation and scale. Candidates who have built in scrappy, high-complexity environments will be better prepared for this role than those who have only operated mature platforms in static environments. In this role, you'll:  Own and operate Wave's MDM platforms across ChromeOS (GWS Admin Console), macOS (Jamf), Android, (and Linux environments): configuration, policy design, maintenance, and roadmap. raw.title: Senior Endpoint Engineer
raw.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for a Sr Endpoint Engineer who's excited about consolidating and updating legacy systems with an eye for automation. You'll be responsible for the MDM platforms, endpoint policies, device deployment pipelines, and fleet tooling that underpin how every employee at Wave interacts with their device. This role blends architectural ownership with hands-on execution, requiring you to deliver scalable, resilient, and compliant endpoint solutions in a fast growth environment.

You'll own the endpoint function end-to-end: platform and policy design, provisioning standards, fleet reporting, and security integration. You'll work closely with Information Security, IT, and People Operations, and you'll be the person who sets the technical direction for how Wave manages devices at scale. The first year will be weighted toward remediation and foundation-building before shifting toward automation and scale. Candidates who have built in scrappy, high-complexity environments will be better prepared for this role than those who have only operated mature platforms in static environments.

In this role, you'll: 

  • Own and operate Wave's MDM platforms across ChromeOS (GWS Admin Console), macOS (Jamf), Android, (and Linux environments): configuration, policy design, maintenance, and roadmap.
    • Manage ChromeOS device policy in Google Workspace: enrollment configuration, org unit structure, security policies, extension management, and OS version enforcement across the majority of the fleet.
  • Design and enforce endpoint security policies in collaboration with Information Security, including EDR integration (CrowdStrike Falcon), compliance baselines, and patch management.
  • Build and maintain automated deployment pipelines for OS updates, software distribution, and configuration changes: minimizing manual intervention and maximizing consistency. 
  • Define and manage the device lifecycle: provisioning standards, imaging, refresh cycles, decommission processes, and fleet reporting.
  • Establish cross-platform compatibility standards and tooling for a heterogeneous fleet (macOS, Linux, Android, with awareness of ChromeOS and Windows edge cases).
  • Build the tooling and runbooks that Local IT teams use to execute provisioning and onboarding on the ground. You set the standard, they execute it.
  • Own fleet observability: dashboards, compliance reporting, patch currency metrics, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Evaluate and own vendor relationships for endpoint tooling, including MDM, patch management, and related platforms.
  • Mentor junior profiles working in endpoint and device management.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Wherever you are based, you must have reliable Internet access and have work authorization.
  • Wave covers travel once per year to one of our operating countries in Africa, as well as a yearly stipend of $1,200 to meet with coworkers.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your experience level and location, we are offering a salary range of $96,500 to $133,100 USD (paid in your local currency equivalent) plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country)
    • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance
    • Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching

Requirements

  • BA in Computer Science, Economics, Data Analytics, or equivalent experience in the required field.
  • 5+ years in endpoint engineering or systems engineering with hands-on ownership of multi-platform fleets at scale.
  • Demonstrated strong understanding of two out of the following:
    • ChromeOS fleet management via Google Workspace Admin Console (device policy, org unit design, forced installs, Context-Aware Access).
    • Deep macOS expertise: Jamf administration, macOS internals, configuration profiles, extension attributes, scripting (Bash, Python, or Swift).
    • Android MDM experience: enterprise enrollment, policy enforcement, and management via Android Enterprise (EMM/MDM platforms)
    • Linux endpoint management experience: package management, configuration tooling (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or similar), and hardening
  • Windows/Intune experience is not required, but can be considered applicable if enough strength in our existing device fleet is demonstrated.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint security principles: EDR integration, compliance baselines (CIS, SOC2), certificate management, and disk encryption enforcement.
  • Familiarity with identity and access tooling as it touches endpoints:  SSO, certificate-based auth, conditional access policies (Okta or equivalent).
  • Scripting and automation capability sufficient to build reliable deployment pipelines and reduce manual operational work.
  • Fleet reporting and observability, meaning you can tell leadership the compliance posture of the fleet at any time.

You might be a good fit if you 

  • You've owned an endpoint function through a period of growth or organizational change, not just maintained a stable one.
  • You build for the people executing on the ground. Your runbooks actually work, your tooling has sensible defaults, and your policies account for the reality of field operations.
  • You can communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to InfoSec, IT leadership, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You're comfortable operating with ambiguity and incomplete inventory data, and your first instinct is to establish observability, not assume things are fine.
  • You have experience with CrowdStrike Falcon or equivalent EDR platforms
  • Prior work in a fintech or regulated industry with compliance-driven endpoint requirements
  • Have French language skills or an interest in learning French
  • Experience managing device fleets in multi-country markets, ideally including emerging market contexts.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you have supporting material, please submit that as part of your application.

  • Familiarity with Linux fundamentals and the command line

  • Some exposure to working with data — SQL, NoSQL, CSVs and scripts, or data coursework

  • Excellent communication skills: you can explain a technical concept simply, to a technical or non-technical audience, in writing and in person

  • Curiosity about how businesses and physical operations work — one week you might be learning about battery telemetry, the next about network monitoring

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for figuring things out: the best people in this role treat "I don't know yet" as the start of the fun

  • Fluent written and spoken English

Bonus points if you have

  • Tinkered with hardware, sensors or microcontrollers — Raspberry Pi, Arduino, home automation, robotics, vehicles

  • Any exposure to IoT or industrial technologies: MQTT, OPC-UA, SCADA, PLCs, telemetry

  • Used monitoring or observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus or InfluxDB itself

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or a cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: Deal Operations Manager
description: About us At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia. We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do. Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace. About the Role We're looking for a Deal Operations Manager to sit at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product, helping structure, price, and close complex enterprise deals. You'll be the operational backbone of our sales motion — ensuring deals move quickly, accurately, and profitably from proposal to signature. What you'll do Own end-to-end deal support: structuring pricing, building proposals, and running approval workflows for enterprise and strategic deals. Partner with Sales to design and maintain deal desk processes, discounting guardrails, and approval matrices that balance speed with governance. Work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Product to unblock non-standard terms, custom packaging, and multi-year/multi-product deals. Build and maintain tools/dashboards (Salesforce, Sheets, or internal systems) to track deal pipeline, cycle time, and win/loss trends. Analyze deal data to identify bottlenecks in the sales cycle and recommend process improvements. Support quote-to-cash processes, ensuring accuracy in contract terms, billing setup, and revenue recognition handoffs. Own special projects related to pricing strategy, packaging, discounting policy, and international deal structures. Leverage AI-native tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to automate repetitive deal workflows and create scalable systems. What you'll bring 3+ years of experience in deal desk, sales operations, revenue operations, or management consulting. Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort with financial modeling and deal economics (discounting, margin, ARR impact). Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and contract/CLM tools (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign). High attention to detail — you catch pricing errors and contract inconsistencies before they become problems. Ability to manage multiple live deals simultaneously under time pressure without sacrificing accuracy. Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations to Sales leadership and executives. A proactive, builder mentality — comfortable creating process from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Our values Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work. Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it. Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve. Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time. Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements. We are hiring an Executive Assistant to the Founders to own the calendars, correspondence, travel, and follow-through of our two co-founders.

Pairs is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

The two co-founders carry the work that decides this company: product, clients, the investor network, the brand. Their time is the scarcest resource in the business, and protecting it will be your mandate. You manage both calendars across time zones, own both inboxes, plan and oversee travel, prepare the founders for the meetings that matter, and ensure every commitment they make is kept. This is a position of ownership, not a list of tasks. You exercise judgment, act independently, and involve the founders only when a decision genuinely requires them. You work AI-first, like the rest of the company: tooling carries the mechanical work, and your time goes to judgment, anticipation, and trust. You report directly to both co-founders and hold one of the most trusted positions in the company.

What you will own

  • Both calendars across time zones: scheduling, conflicts resolved before they surface, preparation time protected, and our Monday and Thursday meeting rhythm maintained.

  • Both inboxes: triaged daily, replies drafted in each founder's voice, nothing important left waiting.

  • Travel end to end: planned, booked, briefed, and resolved in real time when plans change.

  • Meeting preparation and follow-through: the right briefing beforehand, actions captured and pursued afterward.

  • The commitment layer: what the founders have promised, to whom, by when, tracked to completion.

  • The systems behind it all, built on the best AI tooling, so mechanical work never requires attention twice.

You are a fit if you

  • Have supported a founder or C-level executive at a fast-moving company, and can describe what never required their attention because of you.

  • Have managed calendars across three or more time zones and understand the craft: buffers, batching, protected working time, and declining requests on someone else's behalf with grace.

  • Write well enough to draft in another person's voice, and judge well enough to know what can be sent without asking.

  • Have owned travel end to end, including disruptions resolved before the principal ever felt them.

  • Can support two principals at once: competing priorities held, both agendas moving, neither founder resolving minor conflicts.

  • Treat discretion as a reflex: names, transactions, and conversations remain confidential, always.

  • Build systems rather than task lists: standing rhythms, documented processes, and automation that outlasts your busiest week.

  • Operate with modern tooling: AI runs your scheduling, briefings, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment rather than administration.

What we offer

Fully remote. This position operates in real time across the founders' working day rather than asynchronously. Meetings across the company batch on Mondays and Thursdays, and you are the one who maintains that rhythm. The best AI tooling, paid (Claude Code, Cursor, top models). Direct trust from both co-founders, full visibility into the company, and a position that grows as the company does.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Please do not include the names of former principals or any of their confidential matters; we evaluate how you work, not who you have worked for.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><img src="https://www.relexsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/relex-greenhouse-banner-top.png" alt="" width="1280" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div><h2>What we do</h2> <p>RELEX Solutions delivers a unified supply chain planning platform for retailers and manufacturers, enabled by proven AI technology. We help companies optimize demand forecasting, replenishment, merchandising, pricing and promotions, supply chain operations, and production planning across the end-to-end value chain.</p> <p>With a global team of over 2,000 professionals, we work side-by-side with our customers to solve real problems with lasting impact. Companies trust RELEX to increase product availability, boost sales, deliver actionable insights, improve sustainability, and drive profitable growth. Join us and make an impact on the world and your career!</p> <p>In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Merchandising team in [NEEDS INPUT: location].</p> <p>Merchandising is where retailers decide what to sell, where, and at what price. Those decisions ripple out into less waste, better-stocked shelves, and fairer pricing for millions of shoppers. A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is embedded directly in the customer's environment to make that happen: configuring, extending and building on the RELEX platform against one customer's real operational context. Where our product engineers build one capability for every customer, you work the other way round, one customer and many capabilities, until their supply chain measurably runs better.</p> <p>The role is embedded by design. You'll spend meaningful stretches of an engagement on-site with customers, heaviest around discovery and go-live, so willingness to travel is a condition of the role rather than an occasional extra.</p> <h2>What we need you to do and be</h2> <p>Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.</p> <ul> <li>Own technical delivery end to end, from discovery through go-live: configuration, extensions, integrations, and the quality of everything that ships into the customer's instance</li> <li>Prove the value you deliver by instrumenting deployments, measuring outcomes against the customer's baseline, and presenting the evidence credibly to operational users and executives alike</li> <li>Own the technical customer relationship, learning their operations deeply enough to challenge requirements and become their first call when a new problem appears</li> <li>Feed the product by capturing gaps and use cases from the field and prototyping solutions that can graduate into the RELEX roadmap</li> <li>Build customer self-sufficiency through knowledge transfer and clean handovers, so they can operate and extend RELEX without you</li> <li>Grow the account by surfacing adjacent use cases, new sites and unused capabilities, and shaping the technical solution and value case together with pre-sales and the account team</li> <li>Support commercial activity with feasibility assessments, proofs of concept and technical demos, so what gets agreed is technically grounded</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring to the table</h2> <p>Our five values are our playbook. EU analytics strategy - </strong>Set the analytical agenda, priorities and operating model, ensuring the team focuses on the decisions and opportunities with the greatest business impact.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner with senior leadership - </strong>Act as a trusted analytical partner to UK and European leaders, proactively identifying risks, opportunities and questions where data can materially improve an outcome.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Create clarity around business performance - </strong>Establish a consistent view across acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue, moving quickly from what changed, to why it changed, to what the business should do next.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Lead and develop a high-performing team - </strong>Manage and coach a team of analysts, creating clear ownership, developing independent problem-solvers, and setting a high bar for analytical rigour, communication and commercial impact.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Drive prioritisation and accountability - </strong>Balance competing stakeholder demands, make explicit trade-offs, and distinguish genuine capacity constraints from work that should be simplified, automated, self-served or stopped.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build scalable, trusted analytics - </strong>Drive common metric definitions, decision-focused dashboards, semantic models and self-service capabilities so teams can answer more questions independently and analytical impact can scale without linear headcount growth.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Support European growth - </strong>Ensure new products, brands and markets launch with clear success metrics, leading indicators, diagnostic views and measurement plans, while reusing common approaches rather than rebuilding analytics market by market.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Partner across the global data organisation - </strong>Work closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Platform and other Hims &amp; Hers data leaders to align definitions, standards and reusable capabilities, avoiding local duplication where global solutions already exist.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Increase leverage through AI - </strong>Use AI and modern analytics tooling to accelerate analysis, improve self-service and shift analyst time toward judgement, diagnosis and higher-value decision support.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>About You</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Experience - </strong>7-8+ years of experience in data analytics, BI, or product analytics roles, including at least 2 years of direct team management experience. You have operated as the accountable analytics partner for a business area, market or senior leadership group.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strong analytical foundations - </strong>You are technically credible, with advanced SQL and sufficient statistical and analytical depth to challenge senior analytical work, unpack the methodology and identify when a conclusion is not supported by the evidence.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Commercial and product judgement - </strong>You can turn broad business questions into structured analytical frameworks and connect findings to business economics, customer behaviour and consequential decisions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Executive stakeholder influence - </strong>You have a track record of building trust with senior leaders, constructively challenging requests and assumptions, and influencing decisions rather than simply supplying analysis.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>People leadership - </strong>You have developed strong analysts, set clear expectations, raised performance standards and handled difficult performance or prioritisation decisions when required.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Excellent prioritisation - </strong>You create clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and are comfortable saying no, not yet, or there is a better way when demand exceeds capacity.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Builder mindset - </strong>You improve the system around the team through common definitions, reusable analysis, self-service, tooling and clear ownership rather than solving every problem with another dashboard or additional headcount.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Modern analytics experience -&nbsp;</strong>You are comfortable with modern warehouses, transformation tooling and BI platforms such as BigQuery, dbt and Sigma/Looker or equivalents. You understand semantic modelling and data quality well enough to partner effectively with engineering teams, but this is an Analytics leadership role rather than a Data Engineering role.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Forward-looking approach - </strong>You understand how AI and automation are changing Analytics and have a pragmatic view of where they can materially increase team and stakeholder leverage.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <p>UK and European leadership see Analytics as part of how they run the business, not a service they call after a question appears.</p> <p>Your team understands the decisions its stakeholders are making, catches important changes early, explains their drivers clearly and influences what happens next. At the same time, you are building an analytics model that scales across markets through common definitions, trusted data, effective self-service and strong integration with the wider Hims &amp; Hers data organisation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. And equip teams across the organization with the tools, guidelines, and frameworks to create high-quality content at scale, including standards, reusable templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, speed, and quality.</li> <li><strong>Budget Management:</strong> Manage and allocate budget for campaign production resources across all campaign and persona needs, including original content, video production, localization, and agencies to ensure efficient and high-quality execution and return on investment</li> <li><strong>Global team leadership: </strong>Manage a team with a global remit that spans all regions from the US to Europe to Asia, while working with company and brand leadership to execute all top-of-funnel campaigns.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, AEM, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Canva</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote based in Ireland or the UK</p> <p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As a Product Manager for Business Technology, you will own internal products that shape how Anthropic works with Claude. You will embed with internal customer teams such as Legal, IT, GTM, Product, Finance, and Security to understand how they work, find where Claude can remove friction, and ship software and automation that changes their outcomes. This role requires strong product judgment, comfort with technical systems, and the ability to turn messy internal needs into clear priorities.</p> <p>You will work closely with engineering, IT, IT Engineering, Security, and the teams you serve. You will own outcomes, not features. Adoption and measured business impact are how your work is judged.</p> <h2><strong>Core responsibilities</strong></h2> <p><strong>Internal product ownership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the roadmap for Claude-powered internal products and automation across one or more customer functions.</li> <li>Run intake and prioritization so that the highest-impact problems get built first and the rest get a clear answer.</li> <li>Write crisp problem statements and requirements that engineers can act on without rework.</li> <li>Ship iteratively, gather feedback from the people using the product, and keep improving it after launch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Adoption and business impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-develop adoption roadmaps with internal customer teams and hold both sides to them.</li> <li>Define success metrics before work starts and report adoption and business impact on a regular cadence.</li> <li>Treat change management as part of the product. Plan rollout, training, and support so that what you ship gets used.</li> <li>Kill or rework products that are not earning their keep.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with leaders in the functions you serve and translate their needs into product priorities.</li> <li>Partner with IT, IT Engineering, and Security on access, data handling, and governance so that internal Claude usage follows internal policy.</li> <li>Coordinate with Legal and Finance on the requirements that apply to your products.</li> <li>Communicate plans, progress, and tradeoffs clearly to the teams and leaders you work with.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Understand how Claude, internal systems, and integrations fit together well enough to make sound scoping and sequencing calls.</li> <li>Partner with engineering on architecture choices that keep internal products maintainable and secure.</li> <li>Stay current on Claude capabilities and bring new ones to internal teams where they fit.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have deep product management experience, including ownership of products used by internal teams.</li> <li>You have shipped products that measurably changed how a team or function works.</li> <li>You have partnered with engineering, IT, and security teams on technical products.</li> <li>You communicate clearly in writing and in person. You can explain a tradeoff to an executive and a requirement to an engineer.</li> <li>You are comfortable operating with ambiguity and setting priorities across competing requests.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have built with LLMs or agent tooling.</li> <li>You have worked on IT, internal tools, or business systems products.</li> <li>You have led change management or rolled out new tools across an organization.</li> <li>You know security and data-handling practices for internal systems.</li> </ul> <p>Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£190,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£240,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research.
