Junior Space Systems Engineer

Location: London, UK (on-site, Borough / London Bridge)

Type: Full-time

Level: Junior / early-career - ideal for someone coming off a graduate scheme, though exceptional recent graduates with strong project experience are very welcome

Compensation: £35,000–£45,000 depending on experience, plus meaningful equity through our government-backed EMI scheme

_____

We are Foundational

We're an early-stage, mission-driven startup tackling one of the hardest and most exciting engineering challenges in the space domain: building the most precise understanding of space and Earth using ground-based lasers.

Using satellite laser ranging (SLR) and space debris laser ranging (SDLR) data, we're giving the next generation of space companies exquisite orbital data - the foundation for resilient navigation, Earth observation, and precise space traffic control. This is essential infrastructure for the sustainability and resilience of the space domain, and we think it will be foundational to the future economy.

Our network doesn't stop at the ground. To close the loop on precision, we're building the small optical payloads that fly on-orbit and talk back to our stations, and the systems engineering that ties ground, space, and data platform into one coherent whole. That's where you come in.

The role

This is a hands-on engineering role where the successful candidate will be as happy working in the lab as they are behind a computer. You'll work in our space team but may get involved in ground systems as well - helping to define what we build, model it, then get hands-on to build, test, and prove it.

You'll see the full lifecycle: early concept and trade studies, through modelling and design, into integration, environmental test, and validation against our ground network. It's physics-first, hands-on work with a quick path from your bench to orbit. You'll sit in a small team of software and hardware engineers who don't draw hard lines between disciplines, and you'll be expected to cross those lines too.

Specifically, you'll get stuck into:

  • Systems engineering. Turning mission needs into requirements, interfaces, and budgets (mass, power, link, pointing, timing, error). Running trade studies and making the case for a design decision with numbers behind it.

  • Modelling & analysis. Building performance models - radiometry and link budgets, atmospheric transmission, pointing and attitude, detection probability - and using them to drive real design choices rather than to decorate them.

  • Design & build. Contributing to the design of small space-based payloads and ground subsystems: component selection, layout, tolerancing, and assembly of hardware and optical benches alongside our senior engineers.

  • Integration, test & verification. Assembling and aligning hardware, then putting it through environmental qualification (thermal, vibration, vacuum) and performance characterisation - and learning first-hand what survives launch.

  • Ground-to-space validation. Working with the ground systems team to validate ranging precision and pointing accuracy end-to-end, so the payload and the network behave as one system.

  • Owning your corner. Documenting designs, feeding lessons into the next iteration, and taking real responsibility for a slice of the system as we grow.

What we're looking for

You don't need flight heritage or a decade of experience. We care far more about strong fundamentals, hunger, and the ability to learn fast in a hands-on environment.

Essential

  • A degree in space systems engineering, aerospace or mechanical or electrical engineering, physics, or a closely related field.

  • Strong engineering and physics fundamentals, and the instinct to reach for a first-principles estimate before an opinion.

  • Some practical engineering experience - a graduate scheme, internship, placement year, or a serious university project or competition team. What matters is that you've built something real and dealt with the consequences.

  • Hands-on instincts. You like building, aligning, breaking, and fixing hardware, not only simulating it.

  • Scripting ability for analysis and modelling (Python preferred; MATLAB or similar is fine).

  • Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You're energised by a startup where scope is broad, priorities shift, and nobody hands you a fully-specified task list.

  • Clear communication and a collaborative, low-ego approach to working across software and hardware.

  • The right to work in the UK.

Nice to have - genuinely optional

  • Hands-on experience with space hardware: CubeSats or smallsats, optical ground stations, LiDAR, or laser systems. Academic projects and competitions absolutely count.

  • Familiarity with orbital mechanics and the formats that go with it (TLEs, CPF/CRD).

  • Exposure to environmental or space qualification testing.

  • Optics fundamentals - geometrical and physical optics, radiometry, detectors and laser sources - or exposure to optical design software (Zemax, Code V).

  • Comfort in Linux environments, or experience writing instrument control and data-analysis code.

  • Awareness of laser safety standards (e.g. BS EN 60825).

  • FPGA or embedded work, particularly for timing applications.

Why Foundational

  • Real ownership. A high-impact role with genuine autonomy in a new startup - your contributions directly shape our product and our success.

  • Cutting-edge work. Meaningful, challenging, complex problems at the frontier of the space domain.

  • Equity that matters. Government-backed EMI scheme options in a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

  • A team worth learning from. A dynamic, collaborative environment built on innovation, creativity, and teamwork - with room to grow fast.

  • A mission you can believe in. What we build underpins the future of Earth observation and space traffic control.

Foundational is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people. Role Overview The Social Content Producer is a hands-on creative role, focused on the day-to-day ideation, capture, editing, and delivery of Healf’s social content. As a key player in bringing content to life, the Social Content Producer will collaborate with wider comms and partnership teams to bring a range of concepts to life. Optimise content for saves, shares, and reach, constantly pushing for creative assets that drive engagement. Drive ownable formats forward, working with talent to create unmistakably Healf series. Edit final assets using Final Cut Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and other tools within the Adobe Creative Suite. Bring Healf’s product curation to life in creative, social formats that go beyond aesthetic UGC. Interpret creative briefs and brand guidelines to produce content that is visually consistent and strategically aligned. Contribute to the overall social media strategy and help shape it through original, scroll-stopping ideas. Assist in pre-production planning, specifically shot list development. Support in managing content calendars, asset libraries, and production logistics. Stay on the pulse of social media trends, emerging formats, and platform algorithm changes to inform content strategy. Work closely with brand and talent partners to bring a range of content to life, including product-first concepts and talent campaigns. Stay in the know of wellbeing trends, brand innovation, and cultural moments. Actively contribute creative ideas in brainstorms and concept development sessions. Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines without compromising quality. Work with influencers, content partners, and other talent to bring social-first concepts to life. Support paid social by adapting and repurposing top-performing organic content into ad-ready formats. Collaborate with the paid social/performance team to ensure creative learnings and platform trends inform both the organic and paid content pipelines. What You Will Bring: 4+ years of experience in social content production, digital media, or a related creative role. Proficient in Final Cut Pro and Adobe Photoshop; strong command of Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, and Lightroom. Deep understanding of social content best practices and what makes content successful across specific platforms. Proven ability to translate strategic briefs into premium, on-brand visual content. Strong visual storytelling sensibility and a keen eye for design, motion, and editorial quality. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Comfortable presenting ideas to cross-functional teams. Strong project management instincts with the ability to prioritise across multiple workstreams. The ability to translate the brand’s tone of voice, mission, and visual identity through original social concepts. What Success Looks Like: Putting Healf in front of new audiences through bold, innovative, and culturally resonant ideas that interrupt mindless scrolling. Consistent contribution to weekly content performance, tracked against reach, saves, shares, and comments across organic social. Delivery of content within agreed timelines and briefs, supporting a repeatable production cadence. Growth in content quality and originality, reflected in improved all-time performance ranking over time. Creating organic content that transitions seamlessly into paid use. Elevate Healf as the leading wellbeing brand, owning the intersection of wellbeing and culture, while maintaining a consistent social voice. The Deal We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have. In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade. We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company. If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it. We are looking for a Senior IGA Consultant to turn access evidence into clear findings, practical access rules and delivery ready actions. The first likely assignment supports a financial services client reviewing who can see and change sensitive client information across Microsoft, data and business platforms.

This is an associate contract. Work is assigned through paid work orders after client approval. The first assignment is expected to be a focused number of delivery days, with the possibility of later pilot, access review and recurring governance work.

Tasks

Working with the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant, you will:

  • Analyse user, group, role, permission and service account exports.
  • Reconcile technical access with the business reason for access.
  • Identify broad, stale, direct and conflicting access, and record the evidence for each point.
  • Carry out role mining and draft role and access matrices.
  • Test joiner, role change and leaver controls, including where old access is removed.
  • Draft clear findings that state the system, affected access, evidence, risk and required decision.
  • Support access reviews and certification so business owners can make informed decisions.
  • Review privileged accounts, service accounts and integration identities.
  • Support access testing for Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and connected business systems.
  • Maintain the findings register, evidence record and implementation backlog.
  • Support pilot testing and confirm that completed changes match the approved design.

You will not be expected to act as the overall design authority. The Principal IAM Consultant owns the target access design and final technical challenge.

Requirements

Essential:

  • Strong recent experience delivering identity governance or access control work in a complex organisation.
  • Hands on experience analysing users, groups, roles, permissions and access grants.
  • Practical role mining and role based access control experience.
  • Experience designing or operating access reviews, certification and recertification.
  • Experience testing joiner, role change and leaver controls.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint permissions.
  • Experience reviewing privileged accounts, service accounts or integration access.
  • Able to write short, evidence based findings in plain English.
  • Comfortable working independently from source records and recorded interviews.
  • Based in the United Kingdom and available during UK business hours.
  • Available for short, clearly scoped assignments that may grow after client approval.

Strong advantage:

  • Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated business.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data platform.
  • Experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or another identity governance platform.
  • Experience of segregation of duties analysis.
  • Experience reviewing AI tools or connectors that can reach company information.
  • Relevant Microsoft identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CISSP, CISM or ISO 27001 certification.

Please apply only if you have personally analysed access evidence and turned it into findings or role design. General project coordination or user administration alone is not enough.

Benefits

  • Indicative rate of £425 to £500 per day, depending on the assignment and depth of relevant experience.
  • Fully remote work within the United Kingdom.
  • Clear work orders, agreed days and defined outputs before each assignment starts.
  • Direct access to the Engagement Director and Principal IAM Consultant.
  • Focused work on real access problems in regulated organisations.
  • Potential follow on work across design, pilot delivery, access reviews and recurring governance.
  • Prompt payment against agreed timesheets and completed work.

Please submit your CV and answer the application questions fully.

We will first check whether your recent work matches the evidence analysis and role design needed. Suitable candidates will then have a short screening call and a structured technical discussion based on a real access scenario.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 5000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are looking for a resourceful, ambitious, and autonomous sales specialist, preferably with a strong understanding of SaaS or Payments, eager to contribute to ambitious growth plans. This is an exciting time for you to join: based on the size and breadth of our customers, we are growing like never before! As a key member of our Sales team, your primary focus will be to convert qualified leads into delighted Paddle customers. You'll engage directly with a diverse range of companies, from SaaS, AI & mobile app companies to established enterprise businesses within these landscapes, as they explore their e-commerce provider needs. Your role is critical in helping us define, drive, and achieve our revenue targets, ultimately bringing us closer to our vision of making Paddle the go-to solution for SaaS businesses worldwide. title: (Senior) Solution Architect & Bid Manager (m/w/d) – Commercial Solutions
description: 1KOMMA5° Bei 1KOMMA5° verfolgen wir eine Vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . Dafür bauen wir mit Heartbeat AI das Energiesystem der Zukunft. Bist du dabei? Direkt verbunden mit dem Strommarkt – in Echtzeit, vollautomatisiert. So wird Energie dann genutzt, wenn sie erneuerbar verfügbar und besonders günstig ist. Bis 2030 wollen wir 1,5 Millionen Haushalte auf erneuerbare Energien umstellen. Über 3.000 Menschen arbeiten jeden Tag daran, an mehr als 80 Standorten weltweit, von Finnland bis Australien. Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen. Deine Position Als (Senior) Solution Architect & Bid Manager (m/w/d) in unserer Abteilung Solutions Offering prägst du die Struktur und operative Exzellenz unserer Deal- Architektur im Commercial&Industrial-Segment maßgeblich mit. Du bildest die zentrale Brücke zwischen Go-to-Market (Vertrieb) und der operativen Umsetzung (Execution). Deine Aufgabe ist es, kundenindividuelle Anforderungen in technisch umsetzbare, rechtlich belastbare und hochprofitable Angebote zu übersetzen. Du steuerst die Erstellung komplexer Bids und treibst die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Standardisierung unserer kommerziellen Prozesse voran. Deine Hauptaufgaben: Bid Management & Angebotsprozess: Du steuerst komplexe Ausschreibungen(RFPs) und Angebote eigenverantwortlich von der Qualifizierung bis zumerfolgreichen Abschluss. Technisch-kommerzielle Lösungskonzeption: Du übersetzt Kundenbedarfe in strukturierte Leistungsumfänge, technische Lösungskonzepte und belastbare Business Cases. Kalkulation & Pricing: Du erstellst die vollständige Projektkalkulation, berechnest Kosten- und Risikopuffer und erarbeitest Preismodelle im Rahmen der vorgegebenen Ziel- und Mindestmargen. Schnittstellenkoordination & Risk Management: Du steuerst die Abstimmung mit Go-to-Market, stimmst Verträge mit Legal ab und bewertest kommerzielle sowie technische Risiken in engem Austausch mit den Fachabteilungen. Übergabe an die Execution: Du stellst sicher, dass gewonnene Deals lückenlos, vollumfänglich und mit einer klaren Baseline (Umfang, Zeitplan, Marge) an das Projektumsetzungsteam übergeben werden. Prozessoptimierung & Standardisierung: Du baust wiederverwendbare Textbausteine, Kalkulationstemplates und effiziente Prozessabläufe zur Skalierung des Bereichs auf. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im BereichWirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik,Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 3–5 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im Bid Management, Presales, Solutions Engineering oder in der kommerziellen Projektkalkulation im B2B-Umfeld. Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Kalkulations-Software Fähigkeiten: Exzellentes Verständnis für kaufmännische Zusammenhänge, Preiskalkulationen, Margenlogiken und Risikobewertung. Starkes technisches und operatives Verständnis für komplexe B2B-Lösungen/Projekte. Sicheres Auftreten an der Schnittstelle zwischen Vertrieb, Fachabteilungen und Recht. Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, analytisch, durchsetzungsstark und mit dem Anspruch, exzellente Ergebnisse abzuliefern. Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
